primary_mechanism: Controlled misassignment cases must be fixed. On fresh complete games, movement per successful production action must fall at least 20 percent versus R4. Production actions are PLANT,WATER,FEED,CARE,FERTILIZE,HARVEST,COLLECT_FERTILIZER,BUILD,DIG; all counts are also reported separately.
mechanism_scope: Shared task urgency, bonus restricted to edges capable of the necessary operation, full owner coverage and a lexicographic bound consistent with the existing 1.15 multiplier. Economy, market, single-unit feed pickup and ordinary cargo return remain R4.
formal_gates: This three-seed screen does not replace G1 eight fresh seeds or G2 sixteen fresh seeds and old anchors. Failing versions are retired and the opened panel remains diagnostic.
